rca_of_issue: **Ngrok Tunnel Failure (INFRASTRUCTURE ISSUE)**: Both frontend preview URLs return 502 Bad Gateway. Root cause: ngrok tunnel service failing to establish connection. Errors in logs: 'failed to start tunnel', 'session closed', 'remote gone away', 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading body)'. Metro bundler starts successfully but tunnel connection fails repeatedly. This is NOT a code issue but an infrastructure/network issue with the ngrok service or Kubernetes ingress configuration. The app code is correct and should work once tunnel is restored. Mitigation: (1) Check ngrok service status, (2) Restart tunnel service, (3) Check Kubernetes ingress configuration, (4) Test on actual Expo Go app via QR code instead of web preview.
